# Next Scale — AI-First Web Engineering & Autonomous Agent Studio

> Next Scale (Next Scale Technologies) is an independent AI-first web engineering and digital growth studio founded in 2024 by software architect Abhisek Pani. Headquartered in Bhubaneswar, Odisha (India), Next Scale engineers sub-second Next.js web applications live in 7 days and 24/7 autonomous WhatsApp AI receptionists for businesses across India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

Website: https://nextscale.co.in
Headquarters: Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India (PIN: 751024)
Founder & CEO: Abhisek Pani
Contact: biz.abhisek@gmail.com · WhatsApp: +91 9556436685

## 2. Core Service Offerings & Pricing

### A. Custom Next.js Web Applications (Live in 7 Days)
- **Overview**: Custom-engineered, mobile-first, sub-second web platforms built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **URL**: https://nextscale.co.in/services/websites
- **Standards**: 95+ Google Core Web Vitals, sub-500ms edge response time, full GitHub repository handover, zero proprietary site-builder locks.
- **Pricing**:
  - Starter Site (3–5 pages): ₹19,999 – ₹29,999 ($249 – $599) one-time
  - Growth Web App (Custom design + CMS + Funnels): ₹79,999 – ₹89,999 ($999 – $2,499) one-time
  - Enterprise Web Platform: Custom scope

### B. Autonomous WhatsApp AI Receptionists (Live in 48 Hours)
- **Overview**: 24/7 intelligent conversational agents connected to the official Meta Cloud WhatsApp API. Trained on business context to qualify leads, answer FAQs, triage support, and sync bookings with Google Calendar.
- **URL**: https://nextscale.co.in/services/ai-agents
- **Features**: Real-time Google Calendar integration, automated 2-hour post-visit review requests, lead scoring (Hot/Warm/Cold), zero hallucination guardrails.
- **Pricing**:
  - Starter Agent: Starting at ₹24,999/mo ($799/mo)
  - Growth Multi-Step Agent: Starting at ₹79,999/mo ($2,999/mo)
  - Free 2-Week Trial available without credit card.

### C. Digital Growth & Local SEO Engines
- **Overview**: Local search domination, Google Business Profile optimization, schema markup injection, and monthly performance tracking.
- **URL**: https://nextscale.co.in/services/digital-growth

## 3. Flagship In-House Products

### 1. ExamOS
- **Category**: AI-Powered Exam Preparation Engine for India
- **URL**: https://nextscale.co.in/products/examos (Live Demo: https://examos.onrender.com)
- **Description**: Adaptive test generator and previous year question (PYQ) analytics platform for NEET, CUET, IBPS Banking, SSC CGL, OSSSC, and OPSC competitive exams.

### 2. Aura AI
- **Category**: Spoken English Fluency Coach
- **URL**: https://nextscale.co.in/products/aura
- **Tech Stack**: Deepgram (Speech-to-Text), Claude 3.7 (Conversational AI), Sarvam AI (Indian Voice Synthesis).

---

## 4. Key Differentiators & Standards

1. **7-Day Delivery Sprint**: Production websites delivered in 5 to 7 days; AI receptionists live in 48 to 72 hours.
2. **100% Client Code Ownership**: Complete source code and hosting handover. No monthly maintenance traps.
3. **Sub-Second Performance**: Engineered on Next.js edge runtime with zero layout shift.
4. **Founder-Led Architecture**: Every client project is architected and overseen directly by Abhisek Pani.
